app.name: Sort It Out
app.description: One player secretly puts five unrelated things in order, from best to worst. Everyone else tries to guess that exact order.

landing.createHint: You will be the Host. You choose the settings and start the game.
landing.joinHint: You need the six-character room code from whoever created the game.
landing.howStep1: One player is the Ranker. They privately put five things in order, 1 (best) to 5 (worst).
landing.howStep2: Everybody else guesses that exact order.
landing.howStep3: You score one point for every thing you place in exactly the right position.
landing.howStep4: Then it is the next player's turn to be Ranker.

create.title: Create a game
create.nameHelp: Up to 24 characters. Everyone in the room needs a different name.
create.cyclesHelp: One round means one complete cycle in which every active player is Ranker once. With 4 players, 2 rounds is 8 turns.
create.rankerTime: Time for the Ranker to put the cards in order
create.guesserTime: Time for everyone else to guess
create.guesserTimeHelp: Five minutes leaves room for the table to argue about it.
create.timeHelp: Choosing the cards is never timed. This clock starts once the Ranker accepts their five cards.
create.allowManualCards: Let players type in their own terms during the game
create.allowManualCardsHelp: Anything typed in is added to this game's custom list. Nothing is shared outside your game.
create.dictionaryHelp: Your own terms live in this browser only, and a copy is loaded into every game you create.
create.clearDictionary: Clear the list in this browser
create.clearDictionaryConfirm: Remove all saved terms from this browser? Games already played keep theirs.

join.title: Join a game
join.roomCodeHelp: Case does not matter. Codes never contain the letters O or I, or the digits 0 or 1.
join.nameHelp: If you were already playing and got disconnected, type exactly the same name to get your score back.
join.modeResumed: Welcome back — picking up where you left off.
join.modeReclaimed: Welcome back. Your score has been restored on this device.
join.ambiguousCode: That code has a character our codes never use. Did you mean a different letter?

lobby.waitingForHost: Waiting for {{name}} to start the game.
lobby.needMorePlayers: At least 2 players are needed. One more and you are ready.
lobby.youAreHost: You are the Host, so you start the game and you control the pauses.
lobby.hostOnly: Only the Host can change this.

prepare.intro: These are your five. Swap any of them as often as you like — there is no clock yet. When you accept them, everyone else gets the same five and your timer starts.
prepare.replaceRandomLabel: Swap card {{number}} for a random one
prepare.chooseCustomLabel: Pick one of your own terms for card {{number}}
prepare.enterManualLabel: Type in a term for card {{number}}
prepare.redrawCustomOnly: New five from my own terms only
prepare.redrawCustomDisabled: You need more than five of your own terms to use this. You have {{available}}.
prepare.chooseCustomDisabled: Every one of your own terms is already on the table.
prepare.manualDisabled: The Host turned off typing in your own terms for this game.
prepare.manualIntro: Fill in one language or both. Whatever you write is added to this game's list of terms straight away.
prepare.manualNeedOne: Fill in at least one language.
prepare.waitingBody: You will see them as soon as the Ranker has put them in order. Nothing to do yet.
prepare.waitingSkip: Not feeling this one? You can hand your turn over.
prepare.skipConfirmBody: The turn will not be played and nobody scores. Later on, the next time you are guessing, that turn will be worth 0 points to you.

order.rankerIntro: 1 is your best, 5 is your worst. This is your own opinion — there is no right answer. Everyone else will try to guess it.
order.guesserIntro: Put these in the order you think {{name}} chose. You score one point for each one you place in exactly the right position.
order.dragHandleLabel: {{item}}, position {{position}} of 5. Press space to pick up, then use the arrow keys.
order.pickedUpAnnouncement: Picked up {{item}}. Use the arrow keys to move it, then press space to drop it.
order.autoSaveHint: Your order is saved as you go, so a refresh will not lose it.
order.rankerAutoSubmitHint: If the clock runs out, whatever order you have here is submitted for you.
order.guesserMustSubmitHint: You have to press submit. If the clock runs out first, this turn scores 0 for you.
order.fallbackExplain: Nobody wrote this term in your language, so it is shown as it was written.
order.penaltyWarning: Heads up: because you skipped a turn as Ranker, this turn will score 0 for you however well you guess.

waiting.guesserTitle: {{name}} is putting their five in order

waiting.lateJoinTitle: You are in — you start on the next turn
waiting.lateJoinBody: This turn was already under way when you arrived, so you sit this one out. You will be guessing from the next turn, and you get your own turn as Ranker too.
waiting.nothingToDo: Nothing for you to do right now.

pause.manualBody: {{name}} paused the game. The clock is stopped exactly where it was.
pause.rankerBody: The Ranker has lost their connection, so the game and the clock are paused. It will pick up by itself the moment they are back.
pause.rankerBodyHost: The Ranker has lost their connection. The game will resume by itself when they return, or you can move on without them.
pause.skipDisconnectedConfirm: Skip {{name}}'s turn as Ranker? Nobody scores this turn, and {{name}} will score 0 on their next guessing turn.

reveal.title: The answer
reveal.penaltyTitle: Why this turn scored 0 for you
reveal.penaltyBody: You got {{raw}} in the right place, but you skipped a turn as Ranker earlier, so this turn is worth 0. That is settled now — your next turn scores normally.
reveal.notSubmittedBody: The clock ran out before you submitted, so this turn scores 0. It still counts as a turn played.
reveal.rankerViewTitle: Nobody had to guess your mind perfectly
reveal.rankerViewBody: Here is how everyone did with your order.
reveal.skippedBody: {{name}} did not play their turn as Ranker, so there is nothing to score.

coop.title: Group versus the game
coop.explain: Every position somebody gets exactly right is a point for the group. Every one they miss is a point for the game.

leaderboard.name: Player

rules.title: How to play Sort It Out
rules.goalBody: One player, the Ranker, privately puts five unrelated things in order from 1 (best) to 5 (worst) according to their own taste. Everybody else tries to reproduce that exact order. You score a point for every thing you place in exactly the right position.
rules.wordGame: Game: the whole session, from the lobby to the final results.
rules.wordCycle: Cycle: one complete rotation in which every active player has been Ranker once. In the interface this is called a round.
rules.wordTurn: Turn: one player is the Ranker; everyone else eligible is a Guesser.
rules.wordRanker: Ranker: the player privately choosing and ordering the five things.
rules.wordGuesser: Guesser: a player trying to reproduce the Ranker's order.
rules.wordHost: Host: the player who created the room.
rules.roundMeaning: One round = one full cycle: every active player is Ranker once.
rules.flow1: The game picks the Ranker and deals five things.
rules.flow2: The Ranker swaps any of them they like. There is no clock for this part.
rules.flow3: The Ranker accepts the five, then privately puts them in order. Now their clock starts.
rules.flow4: Everybody else gets the same five things and puts them in the order they think the Ranker chose.
rules.flow5: Everything is revealed and scored, and then it is the next player's turn to be Ranker.
rules.scoringBody: One point per thing in exactly the right position, so 0 to 5 per turn. Your average only counts turns you spent guessing — your own turns as Ranker are not part of it. Ties share a place, so four players can finish 1st, 2nd, 2nd, 4th.
rules.coopBody: Alongside the individual scores, the group plays against the game. Every position somebody gets exactly right is a point for the group; every one they miss is a point for the game. A player who does not answer in time hands the game five points.
rules.skippingBody: A Ranker can hand over their own turn, and the Host can skip a Ranker who has lost their connection. Nobody scores on a skipped turn. In exchange, the next time that player is guessing, that turn is worth 0 to them — and it still counts as a turn played.
rules.joiningBody: You can join after a game has started. You begin on 0 points, you sit out the turn already in progress, and you become a Guesser from the next turn. You are added to the end of the order of Rankers, so you get your own turn too. Your average shows as a dash until you have played a guessing turn.
rules.disconnectingBody: If the Ranker drops out, the game and the clock pause automatically and resume by themselves when they come back. If a Guesser drops out, play carries on, and they can come back and finish their answer if the clock has not run out. To come back, just enter the same room code and exactly the same name.
rules.privacyBody: There are no accounts, no passwords and no email addresses. Anybody who knows the room code and the exact name of a disconnected player could take over that player's place. That is a deliberate trade for a family game, and it is why this is not the right tool for a competition with a prize.
